votes.motion: Adopt a single tax rate for the Town of Lunenburg, amended to $14.10, with no action on open space, residential exemption or commercial exemption discounts.
votes.quote: motion was amended by chair jeffreys to include $14.10 as the single tax rate. seconded by member emkey.

votes.motion: Board of Assessors: absorb the recommended change to Clause 41C within the current overlay.
votes.quote: mr. laffond to absorb the recommended change within the current overlay seconded by ms. cammer. call for the vote: three-aye.

votes.motion: Accept the Board of Assessors request to change the low-income senior exemption article as submitted, and let Town Counsel modify the article language.
votes.quote: chair jeffreys to accept the request as submitted and to provide town counsel the ability to modify the language of the article. seconded by member emkey.

votes.motion: Board of Assessors: adjourn the Assessors meeting.
votes.quote: mr. laffond moved to adjourn. seconded by ms. cammer. call for the vote: three- aye.

votes.motion: Suspend the Board policy requiring 60-day notice before putting a question on the Town ballot.
votes.quote: chair franco to suspend the board's policy regarding the requirement for a 60-day notice before putting a question on the town ballot. seconded by member emkey.
member emkey moved to adjourn. seconded by vice-chair franco.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Board adopted, as amended, a single tax rate of $14.10 for the Town.

budget_items.topic: FY2023 levy limit and new growth
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Assessor's presentation of the FY2023 levy limit, the 2.5% increase and new growth.
budget_items.quote: mr. kramer stated that fy2023 levy limit is $424,043,723, plus 2.5%: $701,093, plus new growth: $630,220

budget_items.topic: FY2024 levy limit and maximum allowable levy

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Assessors stated the 41C change would cost the Town $2,500, about $0.57 per residence per year.
budget_items.quote: mr. laffond stated that the proposed change of 41c would cost $2,500 to the town. mr. laffond stated that it would cost every residence $0.57 a year.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Vice-Chair Franco said he would have supported an additional $10,000 request to raise the exemption to an additional $250.
budget_items.quote: vice-chair franco stated that he would have supported the request for an additional $10,000 if it had been brought forward to raise the exemption to an additional $250.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town may exempt up to 10% of valuation for owner-occupied businesses under the statutory limits of 10 or fewer employees and under $1 million valuation.
budget_items.quote: the town is allowed to exempt up to 10% of the property valuation for owner-occupied businesses with 10 or fewer employees and a valuation of less than $1 million.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The skate park non-profit reported raising more than $330,000 toward the project.
budget_items.quote: mr. moore stated that their non-profit has raised more than $330,000 to fund the project.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The road maintenance IFB was awarded to PJ Keating at approximately $127,000 below the estimated budget.
budget_items.quote: she stated that the bid was approximately $127,000 lower than the estimated budget.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: FY2024 new growth was approved at $630,220, and any new growth funds would go toward the School budget.
budget_items.quote: the town manager notified town officials and staff that the fy2024 new growth was approved at $630,220.
